text.p: Larscom Inc said Tuesday it expects earnings per share for its second quarter, ended June 30, to be between $0.13 and $0.14 a share, in line with analysts' expectations.
The company said in a statement revenues for the quarter are expected to be within the range of $18.9 million and $19.1 million.
Analysts had expected the company to earn $0.13 a share, according to First Call. For the comparable year-ago quarter Larscom recorded revenues of $18.8 million and earnings per share of $0.15.
"Revenues in the second quarter were slightly lower than expected due to two opportunities that did not materialize," said Deborah Soon, president and chief executive officer.

"Even with these events, broadband revenues grew 30 percent over the immediately preceding first quarter, and increased to 38 percent of overall sales compared to 28 percent in the second quarter of last year."
The company said its healthy margins in broadband product sales, and its on-going cost reduction efforts, are expected to favorably impact gross margins.
